# Research Brain

A 3-level Zettelkasten-style demo with deliberate link topology.

Entry points: [[Research/Fields/Physics|Physics]], [[Research/Fields/Neuroscience|Neuroscience]], and [[Research/Methods/Statistical Methods|Statistical Methods]].
files.Fields/Physics.md:

Entropy and energy landscapes. Increasingly relevant to [[Complexity Science]].
files.Fields/Neuroscience.md:
# Neuroscience

Cortical dynamics. Deep overlap with [[Complexity Science]] on emergence.
files.Fields/Complexity Science.md:
# Complexity Science

Emergent order. Mutual interest with [[Neuroscience]]; grounded in [[Physics]].

files.Fields/Topics/Emergence.md:

Weak vs strong emergence. Argued via [[Neuroscience]] and [[Complexity Science]].
